assumptions.statement: Official regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities, heritage controls, and engineering constraints are not present in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: No FAR, height, density, setback, road-redline, or construction-ready claim is made.

assumptions.statement: Site and three key-area polygons are the repository's provisional rough geometries.
assumptions.impact: All design layers and geometry-derived metrics must be recalculated when official polygons are released.

assumptions.statement: The key design parcels contain no existing river, lake, open canal, or continuous surface-water system capable of organising the design; ordinary drainage baselines are still unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No water court, wetland, landscape pool, or storage-performance claim is proposed. Public-space design uses dry shade, planting, paving, and reversible components; municipal drainage still requires professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: AI assists observation, simulation, interpretation, and maintenance triage but never replaces statutory approval or safety decisions.
assumptions.impact: Only aggregated environmental data is proposed; privacy review, public notice, human override, and audit logs are mandatory before deployment.

assumptions.statement: The fifteen AI+ scenarios are small-pilot propositions; no medical, education, retail, transport, or public-space operator has committed to deploy them.
assumptions.impact: Every scenario requires a named problem owner, equivalent non-digital service, professional review where applicable, a 30/90-day credential, and an enforceable stop condition.

assumptions.statement: Capital support means evidence organisation, compliance coaching, diligence preparation, matching, and feedback; no investor, fund, amount, subsidy, or financing outcome is committed.
assumptions.impact: The ecosystem can improve project readiness but cannot claim investment, public funding, procurement, or enterprise attraction as a confirmed result.

assumptions.statement: The One Millimeter Commons, annual calendar, funding mix, KPI targets, and staffing model are proposed operating mechanisms without an appointed legal entity or approved budget.
assumptions.impact: A 30-day sponsor/owner confirmation and a 90-day no-personal-data pilot must precede any annual programme; unsupported operations must be reduced or stopped.

assumptions.statement: The six-stop route is a thematic narrative, not a definitive inventory of railway or Zhongguancun heritage resources.
assumptions.impact: Specific dates, artefacts, alignments, attachment methods, and archival images require authoritative historical, heritage, and copyright review.

assumptions.statement: The Open-Source Evidence Gallery and Agent Contribution Wall are proposed contribution records rather than rankings or official awards.
assumptions.impact: Display requires permission, attributable licences, moderation, version history, correction and withdrawal routes, and exclusion of personal scores or sensitive data.

assumptions.statement: The JZ·1mm name architecture, rail-gauge mark, colour tokens, and typography are a concept-level visual identity direction.
assumptions.impact: Trademark clearance, font rights, contrast tests, fabrication prototypes, bilingual editorial review, and approval by the authorised project owner remain required.
